warnings.message: Open advisory findings remain for the approver to consider.

findings.message: Approver should confirm that the learner uses an account or role already authorized by an administrator for the required SQS Console actions. No IAM policy is created or recommended.
consolidatedFrom: An exact least-privilege policy must not be inferred. The learner must use an account or role already authorized for the required SQS Console actions.

The accepted sources identify SQS permissions and actions but do not support an exact Console-only inspection that proves the signed-in identity has every required permission before performing the tasks.

resolvedByAcceptedContent.message: Standard queues use at-least-once delivery and can occasionally return messages out of order; use one harmless test message and do not claim exactly-once or ordered delivery.
A Console-retrieved message is not deleted automatically and must be selected and deleted after verification.
FIFO-only requirements remain outside this standard-queue Follow Along.
Receipt-handle capture is preserved only for a future CLI path and is not required by the Console instructions.
Stage 6 provides queue lifecycle awareness only; actual manual queue deletion belongs to Stage 8 cleanup.
The accepted Console receive/delete documentation does not support capturing a receipt handle in the Console; no transient receipt-handle resource was captured.
Cleanup remains manual-only and is limited to deletion of sqs-beginner-test.
No messages, other queues, IAM resources, or other AWS resources are included.
